_doc: Where supplier order documents land and how to recognise them, for scripts/supplier_docs_pull.py (read only, contracts/supplier-docs-schema.md). The invoice, net of credit memos, is the final flooring cost on a Flooring Line Item (Albert 2026-10-06). Verified live 2026-10-06 against info@titanfloors.ca with the app-only Graph credentials (GRAPH_* in .env).
_window_note: 120 days covers every project in payout scope (Project End Date >= 2026-09-01) plus its ordering lead time. Vidar documents from May 2026 and earlier use an older QuickBooks layout the parser does not read (11 seen 2026-10-06); they are reported under errors, never guessed.
_folders_note: Paths are display names from the mailbox root. Staff file each supplier email by hand; a document filed elsewhere is not seen. info@ Sent Items holds 'FW: Invoice' copies of pre-July invoices: deliberately not read.

credit_attribution._note: A credit memo prints no PO or estimate number. It is attached to the one order that invoiced the same supplier code within lookback_days before the credit; two candidates -> flagged unattributed, never picked.

vidar.name: Vidar Design Flooring
vidar._facts: Estimate prints 'P.O. Number: <n>' = the Lightspeed PO-<n>; invoice prints 'Estimate No.' and usually the P.O. Number. Rates are per box with 'NN.NN SF/BOX' in the description; rate per sqft = box rate / SF per box. 'Price includes a $0.20 discount' is already in the rate. No freight (pickup). Trims and nosings are per piece; UL78 underlayment is $0.00. Revisions arrive as 'Estimate - REVISED:' / 'CANCELLED' / 'Important Update' with the same sales order number. An estimate and an invoice can share a number by coincidence (103399).
